audience: No prior Old English; familiar with standard grammar terminology. Self-contained study. Approximately 30 new vocabulary items acceptable.
productive_outcomes: Select the nominative singular article by the taught noun gender.
Produce the thirty selected noun vocabulary targets in the forms specified for this lesson.
Coordinate two definite noun phrases with and.
Produce the specifically taught nominative plural phrase for darkness, without claiming general plural mastery.
recognition_outcomes: Recognize the relevant letters and printed vowel-length marks.
Identify the feminine nominative singular noun phrase in the authentic earth clause.
Understand and translate the extracted clause using explicit support for four out-of-scope forms.
